It could be.  If I can't stop it, then I could at least try to reach someone who can.

That's why I have to apologize. I'm not apologizing for her. She should do it herself.
Vic didn't know what to think. They weren't expecting this at all.

 Vic, I apologize. I should have stopped Billie when she was mocking Tim and I should have stopped her when she was harassing you. I thought it was just jokes and you were ok with it. I didn't notice she was hurting you, even though deep down I knew what she was doing. I should not have been helping her by looking the other way. But those excuses are not acceptable. So, I’m truly sorry, Vic.

dialogNode.text: I don't know if I could stop it but I could at least try! My parents taught me that if someone does not try to stop a crime that they see, they are guilty, too.

choices.text: To me? Why would you need that?

NPC response...That's not true! Besides, I should've done that earlier. Then maybe Tim wouldn't have to change schools.
